title: Graphwright
description: Build a network graph by hand, switch between four layout algorithms, then export it as PNG, JSON, or a share link.
concept: Graphwright is a node-and-edge graph editor: add nodes, drag connections between them, and watch a force-directed physics simulation keep things untangled — or snap into a radial tree, circle, or grid layout instead. Recolor nodes with a tap, size them by connection count, and load instant presets (random graph, branching tree, clustered groups, hub-and-spoke star) to see the algorithms in action immediately.
features: 4 modes: Move/recolor, Add Node, Connect, Erase
4 layout algorithms: force-directed physics, radial tree (BFS from highest-degree node), circle, grid
4 instant presets: random graph, branching tree, clustered groups, hub-and-spoke star
Export as PNG snapshot or downloadable JSON, plus a copy-to-clipboard share link that encodes the whole graph in the URL hash

interaction.mouse: Drag nodes to reposition; drag from node to node in Connect mode to link them
interaction.click: Tap a node in Move mode to cycle its color; tap empty canvas in Add Node mode to create one
interaction.touch: Same interactions via touch — pointer events unify mouse and touch input
